verdict.rationale: The axis applies because the IRS operates machine-facing channels (MeF XML transmission and IRIS A2A) that a buyer could reasonably expect to come with official client SDKs. Nothing in the evidence shows an official SDK. Those channels are credentialed system-to-system rails, which are adjacent building blocks rather than SDKs, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
